name: Kaira Can Company Limited
about: Kaira Can Company Limited manufactures and sells open top sanitary cans, lithographed and plain metal containers, and special containers in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Tin Containers and Ice Cream Cones. It offers cans for dairy products, processed food, and sweets, as well as paint, decorative, general line, and 15kg cans. The company also provides components, including ring lid tagger assemblies and bottoms, as well as built-up and flattened cans; printed sheets; and rolled sugar cones and sleeves for ice cream. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
